messages.subject: problems upon updating R
parts:
Hello everyone,

I updated R (version 3.5.3) yesterday, and upon update an issue has arised.
Functions related to the rgl window (plotspec, warpRefmesh) do not work.
R appears the following message: "Error in rgl.material(...) : NAs in foreign function call (arg 2)
In addition: Warning message:
In rgl.material(...) : NAs introduced by coercion"

Ι saw that other people had the same issue but didin't find a suitable explanation. Any ideas of what is going wrong??

Thanks in advance, 
Natasa

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] problems upon updating R
parts:
Folks,

 

The package RGL has just updated how it handles mesh ‘color’ (material).  This has had some impact on functions in geomorph that plot those meshes.  We are working on the issue, but must first fully diagnose the problem to identify a solution (the symptoms are not always repeatable).

 

We will let everyone know when this is resolved and when a patch to geomorph is available.

 

Dean
